prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production VFX sprite atlas for a retro first person shooter using GoldSrc / Half-Life style effects.
Create ONE precisely aligned sprite atlas on a genuinely transparent background, portrait format, 4 columns and exactly 8 rows (32 equal rectangular cells). No labels, letters, borders, grid lines, weapons, characters or scenery. Each sprite centered in its own cell with generous transparent padding; no sprite may cross its cell. Treat all sprites as individual isolated white / light gray effects, with internal gray shading and strong legible silhouettes, suitable for runtime color tinting. Avoid any colored background, checkerboard pattern, or uniform square glow.
Each row is a distinct elemental visual family, in THIS exact top-to-bottom order:
1 WATER: a short pressured splash of droplets; a radial watery impact splash; one rounded droplet particle; a soft fine mist puff.
2 ELECTRIC: angular branching arc burst; a sharp radial arc contact burst; a short crooked lightning particle; a thin wispy ion haze.
3 ICE: jagged crystalline muzzle eruption; a shattered frost star with needle crystals; one faceted ice shard; a compact frosty vapor puff.
4 FIRE: an irregular fiery muzzle bloom with pointed flame tongues; a scorched radial flame impact; one tiny ember spark with tapered tail; a soot smoke puff.
5 TOXIC: a restrained spore discharge with fine floating points; a clustered organic spore contact bloom; one distinct small spore pod; a thin spore haze. Not acid, not liquid.
6 CORROSION: a short viscous liquid spit; an irregular radial acid splatter with separate beads; one elongated acid bead; a small chemical fume curl.
7 SONIC: three compressed concentric pressure waves with broken bright arcs; a clear concentric ripple impact disk; a short curved wave fragment; faint airy pressure distortion wisps rendered as visible fine gray strokes.
8 KINETIC: a classic asymmetrical muzzle flash with hot white core and small spikes; a rough physical chipped bullet crater with gray rocky radial cracks; one angular flying metal/stone fragment; a gritty impact dust puff.
Columns in EVERY row, left to right: (1) compact muzzle burst viewed approximately toward camera, (2) surface-facing radial impact, (3) isolated small particle, (4) isolated soft smoke/mist/dust puff.
Style: practical painted 1998-2004 FPS sprite art, detailed but readable at 64-128 pixels, semi-realistic organic texture, soft alpha edges for vapor, crisp silhouettes for shards. The purpose is actual reusable game sprites, not a poster. Preserve cell alignment rigorously. White/grayscale only. True transparency.
